consensus_summary: Five-seat manuscript panel round 1 (12_REVIEWER_PANEL_round1.md sha256 f2ba26ae728336a453e372e85ac00b91b38f326f3fd1af0b7fae42e77b27a3cd): mechanical major_revision (F2 on repairable D3/D6 blocks, F3, F5; no fatal; DA 0 CRITICAL / 7 MAJOR). No seat questioned the data, design or statistics (R1 recomputed all twelve Wilcoxon p values and every printed quantity). Two corroborated findings, three severity/direction SPLITs arbitrated, no unresolved dissent.
dissenting_opinions: REV-M1-37 (DA MAJOR 6): the upper-bound qualification of the held-out loss is unlicensed; R2, R3 and EIC list the qualification as a strength; the panel requires the assumption to be stated (REV-M1-15), not relabelling.

REV-M1-39 (DA MAJOR 7): the title attaches 'preregistered' to a design that exists only in the second addendum; EIC and R2 checked the title without objection; the panel requires a response, not a title change.
